name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.gal_smul_mem_kisinLocAinf
summary: Induction over the saturation: kisinAinf is Galois stable, and g·φ^a(E) is a unit multiple of φ^a(E).

steps.claim: Induction along the saturation of kisinAinf(L) by the φ^a E (saturateBy_induction): for x ∈ kisinAinf(L), g·x ∈ kisinAinf(L) (smul_mem_kisinAinf); and if g·(φ^a(E)x) is in kisinLocAinf then so is g·x, since g·(φ^a(E)x) = g(φ^a E)·(g·x) and g(φ^a E) is a unit multiple of φ^a(E) (mem_saturateBy_of_smul).
steps.lean:
saturateBy_induction hx (fun _ ↦ le_saturateBy ∘ smul_mem_kisinAinf (by bound)) fun a _ ↦
    mem_saturateBy_of_smul (associated_smul_of_dvd _ (by simp [frobE_dvd_iff,
    (@frobE_dvd_iff p _ k.chart).1])).dvd (by bound) ∘ (frobGroup_smul_smul ..).subst
